title: City of Syracuse to Host Job Fair on September 24
summary: City of Syracuse is hosting a job fair on September 24, 2026, to fill 50+ open positions across multiple departments, with particular emphasis on recruiting Certified Driver's License (CDL) holders for Water and Public Works roles. The event will be held at CNY Works from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m., featuring on-site applications and resume review by department representatives.
department_refs: Department of Neighborhood and Business Development
